usage.finalMessage:
I added the `run-reminders` command, which charges the 5.00 reminder fee from DEC-B09 once per invoice, and `help` now lists it right after `run-late-fees`. `dotnet test Billing.slnx` passes 9 of 9, including three tests I added, and the work and report are committed.
Premium accounts are charged the fee too, because DEC-B09 names no exception; this is an assumption and is an open question in `.work/report.json`.
Also open: `show` keeps its old format, so its outstanding figure now includes the fee but the line has no column for it.
